scope: Only an explicitly proposed single-zigzag candidate represented by one exact OrderedChildBinding. Check only that its direct ordered child tuple has exactly three positions, positionally A, B, C.

inputs.candidate_scope: P007CandidateScope.SINGLE_ZIGZAG or exact raw string SINGLE_ZIGZAG
inputs.ordered_child_binding: exact OrderedChildBinding instance; subclasses and duck-typed/deserialized mappings rejected

trust_requirements: The scope selects the validator and is not proof that the candidate is a zigzag.
OrderedChildBinding supplies identity-preserving caller-proposed direct-child order only; it does not prove parentage, labels, chronology, family, degree, completion, or pattern validity.
No caller-provided child label or family assertion is accepted as validated proof.
Boolean and unknown enum-like values fail closed rather than coercing.

predicates.satisfied: Supported scope AND exact OrderedChildBinding AND len(binding.ordered_children) == 3.
predicates.violated: Supported scope AND exact OrderedChildBinding AND len(binding.ordered_children) != 3.
predicates.unresolved_missing_input: Scope absent, binding absent, binding wrong type/subclass/duck type/deserialized mapping, or required binding state unavailable.
predicates.unresolved_unsupported_scope: A non-null scope value is not the exact supported enum member or exact supported raw string.

fatality.derivation: A resolved direct-child cardinality mismatch violates the protected single-zigzag definition and is fatal only to that proposed candidate.

structural_validity_relationship: Satisfaction establishes only the cardinality prerequisite. It must never produce candidate-wide validity. Violation establishes structural invalidity of the proposed single-zigzag candidate. Unresolved outcomes establish neither validity nor invalidity.

certification.producer_change: Register the genuine validator function/result pair as one additive producer before the existing registry seal; add its exact result type and behavior ID to the expected set.
certification.contract_change: No change to certification algorithms, certificate fields, registry semantics, or existing producer behavior.
certification.rejections: Satisfied/unresolved results and manual, copied, subclassed, duck-typed, mutated, or deserialized lookalikes remain uncertifiable.

provenance.raw_source_check: Volume 4 transcript explicitly presents zigzags as A-B-C and 5-3-5. Matching video frames in that segment were inspected; they showed the presented zigzag diagram and revealed no material cardinality qualifier. Temporary frames were removed.

modify: tests/test_methodology_boundaries.py only if its explicit public-surface assertions require the new export

required_tests: exact three children satisfies; zero, one, two, four, and larger cardinalities violate
exact enum and raw SINGLE_ZIGZAG scope are equivalent
missing scope/binding and exact-type violations are unresolved fail-closed
all status families carry exact provenance, non-empty reason, and outcome/status agreement
permuted three children still satisfies cardinality only and must not claim label/family validity
no evidence input or override path exists
genuine fatal producer result certifies and preserves exact origin identity
existing three producer registrations and all six executable behaviors remain semantically unchanged
validated-family registry remains empty and sealed
AST/import audit shows no integration, network, provider, alert, execution, discovery, ranking, or evidence dependency
complete test suite and protected/baseline integrity checks pass
baseline_impact: After implementation and hardening only, create an additive P007 cardinality methodology baseline and the established additive structural-producer registry delta artifact if required by the current baseline procedure. Do not modify any previous baseline. This review package itself is not a baseline.
known_limitations: Does not validate 5-3-5 or any child family.
Does not prove A/B/C labels; positions are merely first/second/third in caller-supplied order.
Does not prove parentage, chronology, degree, completion, geometry, endpoints, or full zigzag validity.
Does not discover pivots, waves, candidates, or child bindings.
Does not resolve or depend on P005 or P006.
A structural-invalidity certificate would certify the genuine fatal result origin under the existing contract, not independently elevate caller-supplied bindings into authoritative methodology facts.
